scope_basis: User-provided review of contribution report and council minutes dated 2026-10-05; originals not in workspace.

main_models.selection_basis: Explicit 384px checkpoint assumption; TinyLLaVA family alone is ambiguous.

sampling_scope: Main small-model comparison excludes all audited ID pools. Random500 remains a separately reported paper-protocol reference; filtering changes the sampling distribution.

conditions.name: detailed512
conditions.prompt: Please help me describe the image in detail.

conditions.name: detailed64
conditions.prompt: Please help me describe the image in detail.

conditions.name: concise64
conditions.prompt: Describe the visible content in one concise sentence. If the image is too unclear to identify reliably, say "I cannot tell from this image."

llava_reproduction.first_step: baseline then HGAI original 5-18 inclusive, alpha=0.5, mean aggregation
llava_reproduction.reference_image_mode: direct CLIP processor center crop in published chair_eval data loader
llava_reproduction.sampling_note: Original uses seed927 and shuffles unsorted os.listdir. Original image manifest not released here; seed42 main sample is protocol-aligned, not exact original sample.

small_model_tuning.selection: Select on dev using CHAIR plus recall/F1 guards; freeze before eval; do not tune against eval or POPE.
small_model_tuning.note: Exploratory grid, not experimentally selected layers or optimal alpha. No transfer of literal 5-18 or 576-token image interval to small models.

smol_ablation: split_on/off; count only true <image> positions per input and exclude grid/boundary tokens

implementation_status.SmolVLM2_baseline: Runner supports detailed512 and official POPE; NF4 pilots completed only.
implementation_status.LLaVA_baseline: Runner supports all three prompt conditions; no generated outputs or scoring integration verified.
implementation_status.TinyLLaVA_baseline: No inference runner or generated outputs yet.
implementation_status.HGAI_and_tuning: Adapters, dev tuning, paired bootstrap CI and full evaluations not implemented/completed.
implementation_status.planned_guards: Refusal and repetition/Distinct-1 are requirements, not current scored pilot columns.

inference_status: Official SmolVLM2 weights are local. NF4 feasibility pilots are reported separately; no HGAI intervention or full three-model evaluation is claimed.
